10-08-1871 is August 10, 1871.  
Add 262 days:  
1871 is not a leap year (1871 ÷ 4 = 467.75).  
From Aug 10 to Dec 31: 21 (Aug) + 30 (Sep) + 31 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 143 days.  
262 − 143 = 119 days into 1872 (leap year).  
Jan 31 days, Feb 29 days, Mar 31 days → 31+29+31 = 91 days, leaving 119 − 91 = 28 days into April → April 28, 1872.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1872-04-28
